vegetable papers were prepared from vegetable pulp, which was obtained from the leek and celery by the method of hot-water treatment and then the paper sheets were formed by the method of paper-making.The paper sheets had the tensile strength of 0.8–2.5 MPa, the tearability of 0.5–0.8 MPa and the water-soaking property of 0–2.5%.

leek and celery are suitable materials to fabricate edible vegetable paper, and the paper tearability and water resistance are two key performance parameters to be considered for the fabrication of edible paper.
